Job Location: Abuja
Job Type: Full-time

Supply Chain Manager Job at Hobark International Limited




        
    

        
        Hobark International Limited (HIL) is the parent company of the Hobark group operating in the oil and gas industry. The company was incorporated in 1998, starting as a staffing agency based in Port Harcourt. Currently we have offices in 4 countries with our head office in Lagos.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Supply Chain Manager

Job Location: Lagos
Job Type: Full-time

About the Role
     

            
    




	The Supply Chain Manager will oversee and manage the company's end-to-end supply chain operations, ensuring efficient procurement, logistics, inventory control, vendor management, and regulatory compliance.
	This role is responsible for optimizing costs, improving operational efficiency, mitigating supply chain risks, and supporting business growth through strategic sourcing and supplier partnerships.


Requirements


	Bachelor's Degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related discipline.
	Minimum of 10 years of experience in Supply Chain Management, with at least 5 years in a leadership role within the upstream oil & gas industry.
	A Master's degree is an added advantage.
	Professional certifications such as CSCP, CIPS, CPSM, or equivalent are highly desirable.
	Strong knowledge of ERP systems such as SAP or Oracle.
	Demonstrated expertise in procurement, logistics, contract negotiation, vendor management, compliance, and supply chain risk management.
	Excellent analytical, leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their Application Letter and CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the subject of the mail.

  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "JobPosting",
  "title": "Facility Manager",
  "description": "Tivana Workforce is a workforce solutions company that provides services that unlock the full potential of human capital to drive business excellence and growth in an ever-evolving marketplace. Our Services include Staffing and&nbsp;Recruitment, Workforce Management, Training and Development, Technology Solutions, HR Consulting, Team Retreat Planning and Specialized services.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Facility Manager

Job Location: Abuja (FCT)&nbsp;
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description


	We are seeking an experienced, proactive, and detail-oriented Facility Manager to oversee the daily operations, maintenance, and safety of our premises.
	In this role, you will ensure our physical workplace is safe, operational, efficient, and aligned with organizational standards.
	You will manage vendor relationships, oversee maintenance schedules, lead health and safety compliance, and optimize facility budgets.


Key Responsibilities


	Daily Operations &amp; Maintenance: Oversee routine facility inspections, preventative maintenance programs, and prompt repair of structural, mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems.
	Vendor &amp; Contractor Management: Source, negotiate with, and supervise third-party contractors and vendors (janitorial, security, HVAC, waste management, etc.) to ensure high-quality service delivery.
	Health, Safety, &amp; Compliance: Ensure full compliance with occupational health and safety regulations, local building codes, and fire safety protocols. Conduct regular safety drills.
	Budgeting &amp; Cost Control: Assist in preparing annual facility budgets, manage operational expenses, and identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality.
	Space Planning &amp; Management: Manage office layouts, space allocation, moves, and facility upgrades or renovations as needed.
	Emergency Response: Act as the primary point of contact for facility emergencies and implement robust contingency plans.


Qualifications &amp; Experience


	Education: Bachelor&rsquo;s degree in Facility Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
	Experience: 3&ndash;5+ years of proven experience in facility management or corporate operations.
	Certifications: Professional certifications (e.g., CFM, FMA, or PMP) are a strong plus.
	Skills:
	Strong leadership and vendor management abilities.
	Solid knowledge of building systems (HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire safety).
	Excellent problem-solving, organizational, and time-management skills.
	Clear verbal and written communication skills.


Method of Application&nbsp;

Facility Manager Job at Tivana Workforce




        
    

        
        Tivana Workforce is a workforce solutions company that provides services that unlock the full potential of human capital to drive business excellence and growth in an ever-evolving marketplace. Our Services include Staffing and Recruitment, Workforce Management, Training and Development, Technology Solutions, HR Consulting, Team Retreat Planning and Specialized services.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Facility Manager

Job Location: Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Description
     

            
    




	We are seeking an experienced, proactive, and detail-oriented Facility Manager to oversee the daily operations, maintenance, and safety of our premises.
	In this role, you will ensure our physical workplace is safe, operational, efficient, and aligned with organizational standards.
	You will manage vendor relationships, oversee maintenance schedules, lead health and safety compliance, and optimize facility budgets.


Key Responsibilities


	Daily Operations & Maintenance: Oversee routine facility inspections, preventative maintenance programs, and prompt repair of structural, mechanical, electrical, and plumbing systems.
	Vendor & Contractor Management: Source, negotiate with, and supervise third-party contractors and vendors (janitorial, security, HVAC, waste management, etc.) to ensure high-quality service delivery.
	Health, Safety, & Compliance: Ensure full compliance with occupational health and safety regulations, local building codes, and fire safety protocols. Conduct regular safety drills.
	Budgeting & Cost Control: Assist in preparing annual facility budgets, manage operational expenses, and identify cost-saving opportunities without compromising quality.
	Space Planning & Management: Manage office layouts, space allocation, moves, and facility upgrades or renovations as needed.
	Emergency Response: Act as the primary point of contact for facility emergencies and implement robust contingency plans.


Qualifications & Experience


	Education: Bachelor’s degree in Facility Management, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
	Experience: 3–5+ years of proven experience in facility management or corporate operations.
	Certifications: Professional certifications (e.g., CFM, FMA, or PMP) are a strong plus.
	Skills:
	Strong leadership and vendor management abilities.
	Solid knowledge of building systems (HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire safety).
	Excellent problem-solving, organizational, and time-management skills.
	Clear verbal and written communication skills.


Method of Application
